text:
sam: Heads-up — customer hit a weird case where they send embeddings calls without a dims field and we accept, but routing/quotas treated it as 0 dims and split oddly. Seeing a bunch of 413s after that. Anyone remember the intended default contract?

anya: We never formalized a default dims semantics in the public API. Impl detail used to be: if dims missing, infer from payload shape; if ambiguous, fall back to 768. But ya that's flaky.

mike: Confirmed in logs: lots of mixed-dim batches where one item had no dims header -> splitter assumed smallest dims and created many tiny batches, causing quota thrash. Here's a sample request we saw:

```json
{"model":"embed-llama-768","inputs":[[0.1,0.2], [/*omitted dims*/], [0.2,0.3]]}
```

jessica: Oof. From UX/console POV we should either surface a warning when dims omitted or show a clear hint in the route config that "dims required for multi-item batches". Right now dashboard only shows rate/latency, not per-request shape errors.

shawn: Agreed. For rollout I'd prefer a soft warning first (telemetry + console snackbar), then opt-in strict validation. Hard fail could break customers. Suggest feature-flagged canary.

sam: For short term: can we patch splitter to treat missing dims as "unknown" and prefer coalescing by bytes rather than dims? That would avoid generating lots of tiny batches.

anya: Implementable. Two quick changes: 1) if dims header absent, do coarse preflight: estimate embedding vector length from first input; if inconsistent across inputs, tag request as mixed-dim and send to slow-path that uses size-aware buffering. 2) Emit telemetry tag `embed.preflight.missing_dims` so console can alert.

mike: I'll add the telemetry. KPI: reduce 413 spike by 90% for these cases. I'll push a metric and a Grafana panel under /redwood/embed-preflight/missing-dims. ops-bot: link to current graph?

ops-bot: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/embeds/packet?orgId=1&var-panel=missing-dims — baseline shows spike at 2026-03-08 14:03 UTC.

jessica: For console copy: propose text in route config: "Prefer specifying `dims` for predictable routing. If omitted, the system will attempt to infer — this may affect batching and quota allocation." Add a link to docs. Also add a small badge next to route showing % of requests missing dims.

sam: Love the badge idea. UX question: should missing-dims be counted against route quotas differently? Currently it consumes same token/embedding units but causes more small batches which inflate unit cost.

shawn: Don't change billing rules without legal/commerce sign-off. But we can show an "estimated cost delta" in console for routes that frequently omit dims. That's purely informational.

anya: Timeline: I can do the preflight + slow-path change in weeks — low-risk. Mike adds telemetry this afternoon. Jessica can ship console badge + info in next sprint. Shawn, can you wire a feature-flag for strict validation?

shawn: I'll create ff `embed.strict_dims_validation` and enable it for 10% of traffic in prod in us-west-2 after telemetry stabilizes. console-bot: create flag ticket?

console-bot: Created FF ticket #3421: embed.strict_dims_validation, owners: @shawn, @anya. Link: https://console.redwood.example/flags/3421

mike: Quick note — emit both `embed.preflight.missing_dims=true` and `embed.preflight.inferred_dims=<value>` as tags so backfilling is easier. Also include `route_id`.

anya: Agreed. Also add a small event for any 413 that includes `preflight_missing_dims=true`. Helps debugging.

sam: Does anyone want to take the docs PR? I'll draft but jessica you know console copy best.

jessica: I can coauthor. We'll update docs with a sample request and recommended headers. Also add a lint in the SDKs that warns when user constructs embeddings without dims.

shawn: SDK lint open item makes me happy. That will reduce customer footguns and avoids breaking changes.

mike: Ok I'll push telemetry + grafana panel. Patch plan: deploy telemetry today -> preflight code next Tue -> console badge + docs next sprint -> enable ff canary 10% in two weeks.

sam: Nice. One last ask: can we include a tiny example in console route details showing how to set `dims` header? e.g. `X-Embed-Dims: 1536` — many customers use header pattern.

jessica: Yup. We'll add that and an inline `why dims matter` explainer. :sparkles:

sam: Thanks all. Follow-ups: @mike post panel link when ready, @anya drop PR link for preflight, @jessica update console mock. Closing thread unless something else pops up. :thumbsup:
